title: Le Groupe Figaro and OpenAI partner to bring Le Figaro journalism to ChatGPT
summary: Le Groupe Figaro and OpenAI have announced a partnership to bring Le Figaro's journalism to ChatGPT through summaries and excerpts, with links to the original stories.
